events.title: Tiberius defeats the Pannonian rebels at the River Bathinus
events.description: Roman forces under Tiberius defeated the rebel Breuci at the River Bathinus, and their leader Bato surrendered. It was a turning point in the great Illyrian revolt against Roman rule.
events.html: Roman forces under Tiberius defeated the rebel Breuci at the River Bathinus, and their leader Bato surrendered. It was a turning point in the great Illyrian revolt against Roman rule.

events.title: Columbus sets sail from Palos on his first voyage
events.description: Christopher Columbus left Palos de la Frontera with the Niña, Pinta and Santa María, seeking a westward route to Asia. Ten weeks later he reached the Bahamas.
events.html: Christopher Columbus left Palos de la Frontera with the Niña, Pinta and Santa María, seeking a westward route to Asia. Ten weeks later he reached the Bahamas.

events.title: La Scala opera house opens in Milan
events.description: The Teatro alla Scala opened with Salieri's opera L'Europa riconosciuta. It became one of the world's leading opera houses, closely linked with Verdi, Puccini and Toscanini.
events.html: The Teatro alla Scala opened with Salieri's opera L'Europa riconosciuta. It became one of the world's leading opera houses, closely linked with Verdi, Puccini and Toscanini.

events.title: Germany declares war on France
events.description: Germany declared war on France and prepared to strike through neutral Belgium under the Schlieffen Plan. The invasion of Belgium the next day brought Britain into the war.
events.html: Germany declared war on France and prepared to strike through neutral Belgium under the Schlieffen Plan. The invasion of Belgium the next day brought Britain into the war.

events.title: Jesse Owens wins the 100 metres at the Berlin Olympics
events.description: Jesse Owens won the 100 metres, the first of four gold medals at the Berlin Games. The success of a Black American athlete undercut Nazi propaganda about racial superiority.
events.html: Jesse Owens won the 100 metres, the first of four gold medals at the Berlin Games. The success of a Black American athlete undercut Nazi propaganda about racial superiority.

events.title: US air traffic controllers go on strike
events.description: Nearly 13,000 members of the PATCO union walked out. President Reagan gave them 48 hours to return; he then fired more than 11,000, a defining moment for American labour relations.
